summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression of Kyrenis Pharmacy OS. 22/24 pytest cases pass. Auth, reference data, POS FIFO, replenishment/PO, telemetry APIs, consumer verify, and OpenFDA proxy all working. Two critical defects surfaced: (1) all frontend sample GTINs (08900000000019/26/33) FAIL GS1 Mod-10, so pharmacy Stock-Intake CLEAN & RECALL sample chips both dead-end at Check-2 and never reach recall/inventory logic; (2) Telemetry tab throws a runtime TypeError (Cannot read 'length' of undefined) rendering the tab blank. OCR expiry regex also picks up MFG date first (matches earlier YYYY-MM), causing false Check-1 mismatch.

critical.issue: Frontend sample GTINs 08900000000019 / 08900000000026 / 08900000000033 all fail GS1 Modulo-10. Because Check-2 runs before Check-3, the CLEAN chip never writes inventory and the RECALL chip never triggers CDSCO recall alert. Either regenerate sample GTINs with valid Mod-10 (e.g. 08900000000010 has check=0) and seed medicines.global_gtin to match, or reorder pipeline so recall registry is checked before Mod-10.

Regex '(20\d{2})[/\-.](\d{1,2})' matches the FIRST YYYY-MM in the OCR text. Frontend sample-clean OCR is 'BATCH:CRO241001 MFG:2024-07 EXP:2026-12 MRP:32.50' so MFG (2024-07) is captured instead of EXP, causing Check-1 to fail against QR expiry 2026-12. Anchor the regex to 'EXP' or take the last match.

minor.issue: No caching layer; each call hits FDA endpoint fresh (~1.5-3s). Not blocking, but consider TTL cache.
Cleaned QR before parse via _INJECTION_PATTERNS.sub(...) is fine, but distributor_id / medicine_id are trusted from client without validating they exist in DB — should verify or 400.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' at Telemetry component on tab open. Renders 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay and blank tab body. Likely cause: one of the four API responses returns a field the component destructures without a defensive default (e.g. v.data.volumetric is undefined during first render or an item lacks batch_number for Recharts).

Because backend rejects sample GTINs on Mod-10, the RECALL chip never renders a red CDSCO banner (user sees generic 'Invalid Barcode Checksum' anomaly) and CLEAN chip never writes inventory. Blocks the primary demo flow described in the spec.
React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Some wrapper is injecting a span inside <option>. Not blocking but produces console noise.

integration_issues.issue: Sample chip fills fields but final verification returns Anomaly_Flagged; toast 'Intake blocked by verification pipeline' shown. Downstream inventory never created — cascading impact to POS FIFO demo depending on operator relying on sample.

issues: Hero stat renders '05' with a leading zero for hubs while others render as '109' / '1,694' / '15' — visually inconsistent.

action_items: Fix Telemetry.jsx defensive rendering (defaults for volumetric/spatial/alerts/recalls or optional chaining) — see console stack at bundle.js:6515.

Regenerate sample GTINs so they satisfy Mod-10 (e.g. append correct check digit) AND make seeded medicines[].global_gtin match, OR reorder run_verification_pipeline to run CDSCO recall (Check-3) before Mod-10.
Fix _yy_mm_from_ocr to prefer EXP-anchored match (or take the LAST YYYY-MM in text) so OCR expiry doesn't collide with MFG date.
Landing hero stat: render hubs count without leading zero for consistency.
Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning in StockIntake medicine SKU select.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stock_intake writes telemetry+security_alerts even when the verification fails at Check-1 (no batch parsed) — 'batch_no' may be empty, producing zero-length target_batch_number rows. Guard against empty batch when persisting security_alerts.
verification.py: _INJECTION_PATTERNS.sub scrubs sequences like '--' or 'onload=' AFTER sanitize was applied to QR — this can silently mutate valid GS1 payloads that happen to contain those sequences.
server.py generate_po calls low_stock(request) directly; it re-invokes require_pharmacy_staff (extra DB round-trip). Extract shared helper.

Frontend Telemetry.jsx: setVolumetric(v.data.volumetric) has no fallback (|| []). Any single failing endpoint in Promise.all rejects all — subsequently 'spatial' array remains []; add per-endpoint try/catch or default guards.

consumer/verify-batch does not enforce Mod-10 while pharmacy/intake does — a consumer scanning the same broken GTIN will get 'green', but a pharmacist will get 'High-Risk'. Divergent behavior may confuse trust.
Cookie samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-origin preview, but no CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints — acceptable for demo, flag for prod.

success_rate.frontend: ~65% (Telemetry tab broken, Stock Intake samples produce wrong verdicts, other tabs OK)

seed_data_creation: None (idempotent seed already ran on backend startup — 109 medicines, 5 distributors, 15 alerts, 5 recalls).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_kyrenis_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_kyrenis_api.py -v`. Two intake tests will keep failing until sample GTINs are corrected. Consumer & POS tests are stable. Frontend Telemetry tab has a runtime crash reproducible instantly by clicking tab-telemetry after autofill login.

rca_of_the_issues.sample_gtins_mod10: GS1 Mod-10 for 08900000000019: reversed body 1000000000098 => weighted sum 3+9+24=36 => calc digit 4, but check digit is 9. Same failure for 026 and 033. Sample generator picked arbitrary trailing digits without recomputing checksum. Reproduction: POST /api/pharmacy/intake with any of these GTINs — verification.status == 'Anomaly_Flagged', final_alert.title == 'Invalid Barcode Checksum'.
rca_of_the_issues.telemetry_frontend_crash: Console shows TypeError at bundle.js:6515 inside Telemetry component after clicking tab-telemetry. Screenshot attached. Likely undefined array in useMemo/filter path. Mitigation: initialise all state with [] AND coalesce API values (setVolumetric(v?.data?.volumetric ?? [])).
rca_of_the_issues.ocr_expiry_regex: _yy_mm_from_ocr regex matches first '20YY-MM' in string; frontend OCR text lists MFG before EXP, so MFG is captured. Fix: prefer 'EXP[:\s]*([0-9/.-]+)' capture with dedicated parser, or take .findall(...)[- 1].
